title: The four suites: a class each, a command line on top, the launcher and the gates below
subtitle: Rows: the command line, the class (the interface), the engine under it, the files. Below: the launcher and the gates every run goes through. Red borders refuse. Generated from suites.json.

class.label: the class: the interface of the suite

nodes.label:
python -m GtGenerator
generate-bev, key, have
nodes.note: its own command line of the same pattern (every command is one method call of the class); not yet generated by suitecli.py

nodes.label:
python -m Training
Training.run job.json
nodes.note: suitecli.py generates the commands from the methods of the class; the older words (health, watch, early, compose, queue) keep their own output

nodes.label:
python -m runner
Runner.predict net frames
nodes.note: run from bev_fusion/; the same generator

nodes.label:
python -m Evaluation
Evaluation.run ...
nodes.note: the methods of Evaluation are generated; the adapter commands (qual, quant, list, probe, selftest) keep their words

nodes.label:
class GtGenerator
generate_bev_gt, gt_key
nodes.note: reads a nuScenes folder and writes the BEV GT of every keyframe (map layers, objects, velocity / flow in m/s); names what it wrote with a GT key. Until 2026-11-10 the package was called autogt (D76); the old class name AutoGT stays as an alias

nodes.label:
class Training
check run status stop
resume compare
nodes.note: a job is a json file or the same dict; the rules of the project stay rules (a run that feeds a verdict needs its card, the TEST split its logged row, a resume the person's words)

nodes.label:
class Runner
predict plan tap
time probe
nodes.note: runs a trained network on frames that are not stored yet and stores what it predicts: no ground truth, no loss, a network with a memory always warm (D70, D72)

nodes.label:
class Evaluation
run score compare
report draw_frame
nodes.note: the front door: scores stored predictions against the ground truth, reads the numbers (worst frames, paired comparison, cost), draws frames; asks the Runner for predictions it does not have

nodes.label:
generators, stores,
lane GT, checks
nodes.note: the signature of a store is a hash of the generator's source; versions.csv names the versions (git tags autogt/vN), a faster generator that makes the same GT shares the store of the older version

trainkit is the project-independent loop (accumulation, EMA, schedule per module, clipping, AMP, atomic checkpoints, resume, the stop request); the suite watches the files it writes and never imports the project's network

nodes.label:
the product code,
snapshotted with
the run
nodes.note: bev_runner.py is the shell around the pinned copy of training/ in the run folder; the Runner holds no model logic

nodes.label:
quantitative, qualitative,
cost, stats, comparison,
run store
nodes.note: one paired scene bootstrap for the whole repository (stats.py); the adapters of each problem in bev_fusion/evaluation/ and bev_fusion_lane_center/evaluation/ say what a Subject, a Source and a Task are

nodes.label:
GT stores
data/autogt/<signature>/
one npz per frame
nodes.note: derived data, not in git; regenerated from the tag and the options of index.json. The stores live on D: behind links

nodes.label:
run folder: run.json,
log.jsonl, config.json,
checkpoints
nodes.note: the only contract between the training and everything that watches or evaluates it: log.jsonl, train.log, .done only for exit 0, CONTROL / STOPPED with exit code 75

nodes.label:
ResultSet
<net>/eval/results/<id>/
frames, taps, manifest
nodes.note: one per identity (network, checkpoint, inputs); any question reuses its frames

nodes.label:
metric cards
with provenance
nodes.note: what decide.py reads; the BEV evaluator writes a provenance block into the card (GT version, evaluator code hash, frames, model: reproducibility.md), the lane evaluator and Evaluation write none yet

nodes.label:
run.py: START GATE (card, TEST row, slot, tag)  ->  decide.py: the verdict by the rule written before the run
->  guard_hook.py: the protected files, machine_lock.py, hold.py
nodes.note: a training or an evaluation that may feed a verdict is started through run.py (Training.run builds the exact run.py command; Runner and Evaluation.run called directly are diagnostics, a verdict-feeding run takes their command to run.py)

nodes.label: records and traceability: ledger, schedule, result.py, provenance, package, lineage, keep3, check_git
nodes.note: the ledger holds the judgement of every run, results.md the decided experiment, the result package the numbers and the provenance, keep3 the best three networks complete
